/pull_request feat-6-geo-tiered-cta-mode-toggle {"number":6,"title":"feat: Geo-tiered CTA mode toggle — settings-based buy/trial swap at hydrate level","body":"## Summary

Add a global CTA mode toggle per Adobe geo tier (T1-T4) that switches all placements between **buy-only** (d2p) and **trial-only** (twp) modes. The toggle is implemented as a **settings flag** (not card-level edits) and the swap happens at **hydrate level** in web-components — no fragment content is modified.

## Context

On a quarterly basis, GTM leadership requests sitewide CTA mode shifts (typically suppressing trial CTAs in T1 markets at end-of-quarter). This is currently done manually via Adobe Target — a slow, error-prone process that doesn't integrate with Studio authoring.

The agreed technical approach (from team discussion) is:
- **Settings-based**: A single settings fragment flag per surface/geo controls the mode
- **Hydrate-level swap**: `hydrate.js` in web-components reads the settings flag and suppresses/promotes CTAs at render time
- **No card fragment edits**: Card content is untouched; the swap is a runtime concern
- **Stageable**: Settings can be drafted → previewed on `www.stage` → published when ready

## Requirements

### P0 — Core Toggle
- [ ] New settings flag: `ctaMode` with values `default`, `buy-only`, `trial-only` per geo/surface
- [ ] Studio Settings UI: admin can select geo tiers (T1-T4) or individual countries and set the CTA mode
- [ ] Settings delivery via MAS-IO: `ctaMode` flag included in the settings payload per locale
- [ ] Hydrate-level swap in `web-components`: when `ctaMode=buy-only`, suppress trial CTAs; when `ctaMode=trial-only`, suppress buy CTAs

### P0 — Swap Logic at Hydrate Level
- [ ] **Dual CTA placements** (both d2p and twp present): hide the non-active CTA, show the active one
- [ ] **Single CTA placements**: if the single CTA type conflicts with the active mode, fall back to a Learn More link (author-configured URL)
- [ ] Suppressed CTAs must be fully removed from DOM (`aria-hidden`, `tabindex=-1`, no event handlers)
- [ ] No empty containers or visual gaps after swap — realign remaining CTAs

### P1 — Page Exclusion Engine
- [ ] Auto-exclude pages matching configurable URL patterns (e.g. `/free-trial`)
- [ ] Auto-exclude pages where 100% of CTAs are trial-only (trial-focused pages)
- [ ] Manual exclusion override by admin (add/remove URLs)
- [ ] Exclusion list visible in Studio admin dashboard

### P1 — CTA Pairing & Fallback
- [ ] CTA type designation (d2p/twp) per CTA slot at authoring time
- [ ] 1:1 pairing enforcement per fragment/component
- [ ] Learn More fallback URL as required field for unpaired CTAs
- [ ] Unpaired CTAs without fallback block publishing

### P1 — Preview & QA
- [ ] Studio preview mode: toggle geo/tier/mode combinations to see swap results
- [ ] Preview shows exclusion state per page
- [ ] Errors (unpaired CTA, missing fallback) surfaced in preview

## Technical Notes

- **Settings path**: Settings are managed as AEM content fragments, one per surface/locale. The `ctaMode` flag would be a new field on the existing settings model.
- **MAS-IO delivery**: Settings are already fetched per-locale in the IO pipeline. The new flag rides the existing settings delivery — no new endpoints needed.
- **Hydrate swap**: `hydrate.js` already reads settings for other purposes. CTA swap logic would run during fragment hydration, before the component is attached to the DOM.
- **Geo tiers**: T1 (US, UK, FR, DE, JP, AU, NZ), T2 (remaining EMEA + LATAM), T3 (APAC), T4 (rest of world). Full country list in Studio settings UI.

## Domains Involved

- `mas-studio` — Settings UI, CTA type designation, preview mode
- `mas-io` — Settings fragment delivery, ctaMode flag in payload
- `mas-web-components` — hydrate.js swap logic, DOM suppression, accessibility

## Acceptance Criteria

- Admin toggles T1 to buy-only → all T1 pages show only buy CTAs, trial CTAs are fully suppressed
- Pages with only trial CTAs and no buy pair → show Learn More fallback
- Trial-focused pages (e.g. /free-trial) → excluded from swap, original CTAs remain
- Toggle is stageable: change is visible on www.stage before publish
- No content fragments are modified — swap is purely runtime via settings"} specs/issue-c93e91a4-adw-6-sdlc_planner-geo-tiered-cta-mode-toggle.md c93e91a4
